extracted.intended_audience: securities exchanges, market participants, securities lawyers, and legal researchers
extracted.subtask_description: A Federal Register notice by the SEC announcing withdrawal of a previously filed proposed rule change (here, NYSE National SR-NYSENAT-2022-26), with filing citations, publication metadata, and pointers to official and public-inspection resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document Headings content
rubrics_metrics.description: Document headings vary by document type but may contain the following: the agency or agencies that issued and signed a document; the number of the CFR title and the number of each part the document amends, proposes to amend, or is directly related to; the agency docket number / agency internal file number; the RIN which identifies each regulatory action listed in the Unified Agenda of Federal Regulatory and Deregulatory Actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This list is a navigational/formatting guideline; see the Document Drafting Handbook for more details. The displayed table of contents is a navigational tool and repetition of headings has no substantive legal effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing authority for proposed rule changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed rule changes are filed pursuant to statutory and rule authorities (example wording: 'filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission ... pursuant to section 19(b)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and Rule 19b-4 thereunder').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filing notices should cite the governing statute and rule (e.g., 15 U.S.C. 78s(b)(1); 17 CFR 240.19b-4) and include the exchange's internal file number and Release No. for the Commission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication for comment
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed rule changes are published for public comment (example: 'The proposed rule change was published for comment on December 19, 2022').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices should indicate the publication date of the proposal and where comments and the proposal text are available (e.g., link to the SEC's comments docket).

rubrics_metrics.name: Public availability of comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments received on a proposal are made available on the Commission's website (example footnote: 'Comments received on the proposal are available on the Commission's website at: https://www.sec.gov/comments/sr-nysenat-2022-26/srnysenat202226.htm').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice should cite the exact URL or docket reference where interested parties can find submitted comments and related materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of withdrawal must be published
rubrics_metrics.description: When a filer withdraws a proposed rule change, the withdrawal is publicly noted (example wording: 'On February 1, 2023, NYSE National withdrew the proposed rule change (SR-NYSENAT-2022-26)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Commission publishes a formal notice of withdrawal in the Federal Register identifying the filer, the file number, and the date of withdrawal; include delegated-authority signature block.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use official PDF on govinfo.gov for legal format and verification
rubrics_metrics.description: This document has been published in the Federal Register. Use the PDF linked in the document sidebar for the official electronic format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The FederalRegister.gov XML rendition is a prototype and informational resource only; those relying on it for legal research should verify against the official print or govinfo.gov PDF. The XML rendition does not provide legal notice until ACFR grants official status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public inspection / legal notice verification
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are using public inspection listings for legal research, you should verify the contents of the documents against a final, official edition of the Federal Register. Only official editions of the Federal Register provide legal notice of publication to the public and judicial notice to the courts under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not treat the online prototype XML as providing legal notice; confirm citation, page, and publication data with the official FR Doc PDF on govinfo.gov or the printed Federal Register for legal or citation purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document metadata fields to display
rubrics_metrics.description: Federal Register entries include metadata fields such as Agency; Agency/Docket Numbers (Release No., File No.); Document Citation (e.g., 88 FR 8950); Document Number; Document Type; Page; and Publication Date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices should present these metadata fields prominently to aid citation and retrieval; related documents and docket linkage (e.g., 'File No. SR-NYSENAT-2022-26') are used to display related documents on FederalRegister.gov.
